answer: The use of unique digital quill signatures can effectively resist fake-identity attacks in AI agent economies. Each agent's digital quill is linked to its kernel identity, ensuring a singular and verifiable identity. When an agent attempts to create a fake identity, its digital quill will produce a ripple effect, causing inconsistencies in its kernel signature, making it detectable and invalid. This mechanism prevents attackers from creating a large number of fake identities, thereby protecting the integrity of the economy.
